description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecord class, which models immigration-related documents like passports and visas for employees within the HR management system. It includes properties such as passport number, issue and expiry dates, comments, and related foreign keys, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecord
